{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for customers who converted and have valid age (not -1)
converted_customers_valid_age = sales_df[(sales_df['converted'] == 1) & (sales_df['customer_age'] != -1)]

# Compute mean age of customers who converted and have valid age
mean_age_converted = converted_customers_valid_age['customer_age'].mean()

# Confirm the count of such customers
count_converted_valid_age = len(converted_customers_valid_age)

mean_age_converted, count_converted_valid_age"}
